title: Countries Making New Safety Friends!
content:
Hello, amazing friends all across Africa! It's your kid-friendly news reporter here, ready to share some really cool and important news from around the world. Imagine you have a very special toy, and you want to keep it super safe. You might ask your big brother, or your mum, or even your best friend to help you! Well, big countries do something similar! They make friends to help each other stay safe. Let's learn about it!

A Big Country Needs Friends!

Today, we're talking about a big country called **Saudi Arabia**. Can you say that? Saudi Ar-a-bia! It's a very large country, mostly covered in desert, far away from us, in a place called the Middle East. It has lots of sand and some really tall, shiny buildings too! *Did you know? Saudi Arabia is home to the largest sand desert in the world, called Rub' al Khali! That's a lot of sand! It’s bigger than many countries put together!* Every country, big or small, wants to make sure its people are safe and sound. They want to protect their homes, their schools, and their playgrounds. This is a very important job for any country's leaders.

What is 'Defence'?

Now, every country wants to keep its home and its people safe, just like your parents keep your home safe with strong locks and sometimes even a friendly watch dog! This special job of keeping a country safe is called **defence**. Defence means having special people, like brave soldiers, and special equipment, like strong cars, fast planes, or even big ships, to protect the country from any danger. It's like having a superhero team for the whole country, always ready to protect! These defence teams learn many special skills. They practice to be strong and smart. They work hard to make sure everyone in their country can live happily and without fear.

Making New Friends for Safety

For a long time, Saudi Arabia had a very special friend who helped them with their safety and defence. This friend was a super big country called the **USA** (that's short for the United States of America). The USA has very strong defence teams and they used to help Saudi Arabia a lot with advice and sometimes special equipment. *Did you know? The USA is so big that it has 50 different states, and it takes many, many days to drive from one side to the other! It even has very tall mountains and huge, busy cities.* But guess what? Just like you might make new friends at school, Saudi Arabia is now making two *new* special friends to help with defence! These new friends are two other amazing countries: **Turkiye** and **Pakistan**. It's like adding more players to your favourite game!

Meet Turkiye!

Turkiye (say: Tur-kee-yeh) is a very interesting country! It's like a bridge because part of it is in Europe and part of it is in Asia! How cool is that? It has beautiful beaches, ancient castles, and very yummy food that people all over the world love. *Did you know? Turkiye is famous for delicious Turkish Delight, a sweet and chewy treat that comes in many flavours! Yum! They also have very beautiful hot air balloons that fly over their magical landscapes.* Turkiye also has very good people who know a lot about keeping a country safe. They have strong soldiers and smart plans. Saudi Arabia wants to learn from them and work together to make their defence even stronger. They want to share ideas and train together.

Meet Pakistan!

And then there's Pakistan! Pakistan is a country with very tall, snowy mountains and big, wide rivers. It's a land of amazing stories, colourful festivals, and brave people who love their country very much. *Did you know? Pakistan has some of the highest mountains in the world, including K2, which is the second tallest mountain on Earth! Imagine climbing that high! It also has a big desert and beautiful green areas.* Pakistan also has strong defence teams and good ideas about how to protect its land and its people. Saudi Arabia wants to be friends with Pakistan too, and work together on keeping their homes safe. It's all about teamwork!

Why Have More Friends?

Now, you might be wondering, "Why does Saudi Arabia need *more* friends if they already have the USA?" That's a great question, and it's a very smart way to think! Imagine you have a big, important project at school. You might work with your best friend, but maybe you also ask two other clever friends to help you! The more smart friends you have, the more ideas you get, and the stronger and better your project becomes. It's always good to have different people with different skills! It's the same for countries! When Saudi Arabia makes friends with Turkiye and Pakistan, it means they can share new ideas, learn new ways to stay safe, and have more people ready to help if needed. It makes their 'superhero team' even bigger, smarter, and stronger! More friends mean more safety for everyone.

Sharing and Learning Together

When countries become "defence friends," it means they might: * **Share ideas:** Like sharing good ways to build a strong fence around your house, or how to use special tools to see far away. They share their best secrets for safety. * **Learn from each other:** One country might be very good at using special planes in the sky, and another might be very good at training brave soldiers on the ground. They can teach each other everything they know! * **Practice together:** Sometimes, these countries might even do special practice games (we call them military exercises) to make sure they know how to work together perfectly if they ever need to. It's like a big training session for superheroes!

What About the USA?

So, does this mean Saudi Arabia doesn't want to be friends with the USA anymore? Not at all! It's like having many friends in your class. You can still play with your old friends, but it's also fun and smart to make new friends too! Saudi Arabia is just trying to have a bigger circle of friends for safety. This means they are thinking about new ways to protect themselves, by having many different friends who can help. It's like having a big, strong team with lots of different talents! Having many friends to help means you don't have to rely on just one person for everything. It makes you feel more secure and prepared for anything.

Why Is This Important?

This news is important because when big countries make new friends and decide to work together, it can make the whole world a little bit safer and more peaceful. When countries cooperate, they are less likely to have big arguments or fights. They learn to understand each other better, which is super important! *Did you know? When countries work together and share ideas, it's called 'international cooperation'. It's like a big team effort for the whole planet to solve problems together!* Having many friends means more ideas, more support, and more ways to keep everyone safe. It's a smart way for countries to look after their homes and their people, helping to build a more friendly world for all of us.

A World of Friendship!

So, there you have it, my amazing news explorers! Saudi Arabia is making new friends, Turkiye and Pakistan, to help keep its country safe and strong. This is a big step for them, and it shows that having many friends is always a good idea, whether you're a child in school or a big country on the world map! Friendship makes everything better and safer. Keep listening for more amazing stories from your kid-friendly news reporter. Stay safe, stay curious, and keep making friends! Bye for now!
summary: Saudi Arabia, a large country, is making new friends, Turkiye and Pakistan, to help keep its country safe, showing it wants more partners beyond its long-time friend, the USA.
whyMatters: This is important because when countries work together and make new friends for safety, it can help everyone stay safe and peaceful in the world.
